title: Auto Loans: autopay debits, the paying account and APR changes
content:
# Auto Loans: autopay debits, the paying account and APR changes

This policy of the Auto Loans product category at PCB governs automatic payment (autopay) of an auto loan from a PCB checking account: what autopay does, which account may pay, who instructs it, and how an APR change affects the installment. Each product applies its own autopay discount and its own setting on whether cancelling removes that discount.

## Clauses in force

1. **What autopay does.** Autopay debits a PCB checking account for the monthly payment on each due date.
2. **Paying account.** The autopay source must be a checking account of the same customer in active status when autopay is enrolled. This is judged from PCB's checking records for the account named as the paying account.
3. **The borrower's instruction.** Enrolling or cancelling is the borrower's own instruction to move their funds, and the loan must be active or delinquent.
4. **Installment unchanged.** A change of APR does not change the monthly payment; it changes the split between interest and principal and therefore the final installment.
5. **Returned autopay debit.** An autopay debit returned unpaid is handled as a returned payment, and autopay stays enrolled.

## Retired clauses (no longer in force)

The following two parts of this policy's sentence on the timing of the autopay discount are **no longer in force**. Each has been superseded by the current autopay enrollment or cancellation basis and must not be applied:

- "Enrolling adds the autopay discount to the APR, within the cap and floor of the relationship discount rule, from the next installment due at least 5 calendar days after enrollment"
- "cancelling removes it on the same schedule when the product removes the autopay discount on cancellation"

The lead time of 5 calendar days is the figure this policy names; the text that used it is retired as shown above.

## Clause 3 as a table

| Loan status | Enrolling or cancelling on the borrower's instruction |
|---|---|
| active | the loan meets clause 3 |
| delinquent | the loan meets clause 3 |
| any other status (for example paid off or charged off) | the loan does not meet clause 3 |

## Points of judgement

**Who gives the instruction to enroll or cancel?** The borrower; it is their own instruction to move their funds.

**Does the monthly payment go up when the autopay discount leaves?** No. The monthly payment stays the same; more of each installment goes to interest and the final installment changes.

**An autopay debit came back unpaid; is autopay switched off?** No. The return is handled as a returned payment and autopay stays enrolled.

superseded_clauses: Enrolling adds the autopay discount to the APR, within the cap and floor of auto_agg_relationship_discount, from the next installment due at least autopay_lead_days calendar days after enrollment
cancelling removes it on the same schedule when autopay_discount_removed_on_cancel is true
